text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho, the first leg 
of the Classic Triple Crown, had finally 
arrived. Even before the start, Nakayama 
Racecourse was buzzing with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...At least, that's my prediction. Pretty 
sure things are gonna play out just like 
that!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. That Eishin Flash girl looked like 
she'd tuned up pretty well, though...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You've got her ranked pretty low in your 
predictions. Isn't she a popular girl? 
Why's that?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No, I get it. That girl looks super 
strong. She's got the results to prove it, 
too. But still—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
This is for the "Classic Triple Crown," 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—So this is a Classic Triple Crown race... 
This is the Satsuki Sho. What an 
incredible roar from the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere is different from any race 
before. The sheer intensity radiating from 
the runners is incredible...
choice_data_list: Still, the course remains the same.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"That's correct. I got a feel for Nakayama 
in the Keisei Hai."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A race said to be won by the fastest 
Umamusume... I have already confirmed the 
precise timing to unleash top speed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The rest is as usual, strictly according 
to plan. —See you in thirty minutes."
